item.title: Updated Intel LLM-Scaler-Omni Improves ComfyUI Performance For Arc Graphics
item.description: The past several months Intel software engineers have been quite busy with LLM-Scaler as part of Project Battlematrix. LLM-Scaler is a Docker-based solution for AI workloads on Intel graphics hardware to ship an optimized vLLM stack and other AI frameworks. Out today is a new LLM-Scaler-Omni release to help enhance ComfyUI performance on Intel hardware...

item.title: Turbostat Introduces New Cache Statistics, Nova Lake + Wildcat Lake Support
item.description: Turbostat is the Linux command-line utility for reporting CPU frequency / power / C-states and related performance / power management items namely for modern AMD and Intel processors. This CLI utility lives within the Linux kernel source tree and for Linux 6.19 has picked up a few new features...

item.description: Given the recent release of FreeBSD 15, I started off my testing in looking at how FreeBSD 15.0 improves performance versus FreeBSD 14.3. item.title: Qt Toolkit Lands IO_uring Abstraction
item.description: The newest feature to land in the cross-platform Qt toolkit is QIORing as an abstraction for Linux's IO_uring interface. This QIORing may also end up supporting Microsoft's Windows IORing implementation as well...

item.title: Glibc Now Enabling 2MB THP On AArch64 By Default For Better Performance
item.description: The GNU C Library's malloc implementation is now enabling 2MB Transparent Huge Pages (THP) by default for AArch64 Linux. This is being done in the name of better performance -- a healthy 6.25% performance improvement is noted for SPEC with this change...

item.title: Intel's Vulkan Linux Driver Merges Shader VMA Allocator For Ray-Tracing Capture/Replay
item.description: Merged today to the Intel open-source "ANV" Vulkan driver in Mesa 26.0 is introducing a shader VMA allocator. Long story short this new allocator steps toward enabling Vulkan ray-tracing capture/replay support, which can come in hand for debugging issues with Vulkan ray-tracing on Intel graphics hardware under Linux and similarly to assist in optimizing for better performance...

item.title: Linux 6.19 Networking Delivers 4x Improvement For Heavy Transfer Workloads, New Hardware
